title: AI beats licensed accountants on speed and accuracy, but still can't close the books without supervision
key_facts: A Mercor study had 12 licensed CPAs (average 5.5 years of experience) work through simplified tasks from the APEX Accounting Benchmark.
The article says AI models are faster, more accurate and far cheaper than the accountants at structured bookkeeping tasks.
The accountants averaged about 37 percent; 18 months ago the best models scored below that, and today they solve the same tasks almost flawlessly.
The full APEX Accounting benchmark has 160 tasks across 10 simulated companies, built by more than 40 professionals averaging 11 years of experience.
On it, Claude Opus 5.5 leads with 61.8 percent of grading criteria met, followed by Fable 5.1 at 61.0 percent and GPT-6 Astra at 57.9 percent.
Mercor says no model fully solved almost 60 percent of the tasks, so AI cannot close the books without oversight yet.

Mercor admits the study tests what AI does best (hunting down details, following instructions) and leaves out client talks, colleague check-ins and years of built-up context; it expects major productivity gains but says accountants cannot be replaced.
